lines.line: Last night, a mysterious box showed up at my door.
lines.adds_information: The room and the unopened box on the table show the mystery before the line finishes.

lines.line: I picked it up, and I had no idea who sent it.
lines.adds_information: The hero stays in frame with the box between him and the viewer, so "no idea who sent it" is a visible worry.
The hero lifting the lid is the action itself; the line has no object, the picture supplies it.

lines.line: And inside was a tiny golden key.
lines.adds_information: A golden key rising out of the box shows what the line only names.
The hero's face and posture carry the surprise that the two words "No way." leave unsaid.
